plugins.name: standup-logger
plugins.description: Automatic daily standup logger for Claude Code. Logs session work with Jira ticket IDs to per-date files and generates ready-to-speak standup summaries.

commands.name: standup-log
commands.description: Log current session work to the daily standup file. Use this PROACTIVELY at the end of every coding session — whenever you are about to stop, finish a task, or the user says goodbye/done/that's it/wrap up. Also use when the user explicitly asks to log work. Appends a brief summary with Jira ticket IDs to ~/.claude/standup/YYYY-MM-DD.md so the user has a ready-made standup log. MUST be invoked before session ends.

commands.name: standup
commands.description: Generate daily standup content from your work log. Use when the user asks for standup notes, what they did yesterday, what to say in standup, scrum update, daily sync, or mentions preparing for a standup meeting. Reads the standup log files and presents a ready-to-speak summary.

headings: 2. Install the plugin (user scope so it's available across all projects)
3. Restart Claude Code to activate hooks
